en: This section is about efficient text
workflows in ChatGPT. And don't worry, I'll
not dive into how you can
let ChatGPT generate a summary of a text you
provide.
This is all about turning basic text
prompting into structured, editable
workflows. So we want to make our text
reusable and not just a one-off chat output.
Now for this, in this section, we'll dive
into longer text outputs in the canvas,
a dedicated section, so to say, inside our
chat
that allows us to
edit outputs. We can edit the entire output
or focus on 2 specific section edits.
We will also learn how we can reuse one text
that was generated in such a canvas and turn
it into an email or turn it into talking
points,
and we'll also dive into into projects for
recurring work. Because having one chat is
nice, but typically you might have different
projects you work on. And in a project, you
might need multiple text outputs, multiple
text operations.
This is what this section is all about. So
let's dive into it.
